visible.author: ThomasL
visible.title: Great looking, high quality wheels and tires.
visible.body: Transformed the appearance of my 2017 F150 from drab to like new.

visible.author: Roy Ames
visible.title: Terrible Tires. DO NOT BUY!!
visible.body: Milestar Patagonia ATs have so far been the absolute worse tires I have ever purchased. I purchased them mounted & balanced on rims from American Truck. I put them on and they proceeded to shake the hell out of my truck. Unfortunately, I had to drive the truck to drop my daughter of at college. I brought the truck into my mechanic and found none of the tires were in balance. And one of the tires was so bad it could not be balanced. I had to pay to get them balanced and had to purchase another just to get a usable set. They were supposed to come "balanced". I am not in a position to get rid of them right now, so I am stuck. I wish I could give "no stars"

visible.author: SalvatoreM
visible.title: 2021 F150 AT tires
visible.body: Like the look of the tire overall, didn't want to go aggressive for a daily driver. Very slight road hum but very slight. Otherwise happy so far.

visible.author: moscols
visible.title: Great at first
visible.body: I put these on my F150 4x4 as a less expensive alternative and I liked them initially. Not a negative review but over a couple seasons of wear I experienced that they lost traction with the road consistently. Lots of fishtailing on wet pavement. Bottom line is that I got my money's worth out of them but had lots of anxiety as they got closer to replacement time. I replaced with the BF ko3 tires and really like them

visible.author: Ghost34
visible.title: Milestar Patagonia
visible.body: While there is some road noise that can be heard from the cabin. These tires do offer a smooth ride.

visible.author: JoseGP
visible.title: good for the money
visible.body: they are OK but they are easy to burn out when accelerating. minimum noise for being a all-terrain tire.

visible.author: ScottLouis
visible.title: Milestar for the win!
visible.body: Tires ride excellent, previously had falkens on my truck and these are a big improvement. Thanks american trucks!

visible.author: DusBla2014
visible.title: Great Tire!
visible.body: Tire is great. Delivered right on time and well packaged. This is my second set. Low noise and great durability for many years. I have never had a problem with these tires and will continue to use them!

visible.author: BlackonBlue
visible.title: Great tires
visible.body: Great tires. Run smooth with very little road noise.

visible.author: Tom3381
visible.title: Great Tires
visible.body: These tires are great. The price is good. I have the 33in by 10.5 and they aren't loud at all going highway speeds. Definitely worth it
